question.de: Finde Barra am Nordufer gegenüber von Banjul.
question.hu: Keresd meg Barrát az északi parton, Banjullal szemben.
question.ro: Găsește Barra pe malul de nord, vizavi de Banjul.
question.en: Find Barra on the north bank opposite Banjul.

question.de: Finde Gunjur an der südlichen Atlantikküste.
question.hu: Keresd meg Gunjurt a déli atlanti parton.
question.ro: Găsește Gunjur pe coasta sudică a Atlanticului.
question.en: Find Gunjur on the southern Atlantic coast.

question.de: Finde Kuntaur im zentralen Flusskorridor Gambias.
question.hu: Keresd meg Kuntaurt Gambia középső folyami folyosójában.
question.ro: Găsește Kuntaur în coridorul central al fluviului din Gambia.
question.en: Find Kuntaur in The Gambia's central river corridor.

question.de: Finde die Steinkreise von Wassu im Landesinneren.
question.hu: Keresd meg a wassui kőköröket az ország belsejében.
question.ro: Găsește cercurile de piatră de la Wassu în interiorul țării.
question.en: Find the Wassu Stone Circles in the interior.

question.de: Finde Kunta Kinteh Island nahe der Flussmündung.
question.hu: Keresd meg a Kunta Kinteh-szigetet a folyótorkolat közelében.
question.ro: Găsește insula Kunta Kinteh aproape de estuar.
question.en: Find Kunta Kinteh Island near the river estuary.

question.de: Finde das Abuko-Naturschutzgebiet im Westen des Landes.
question.hu: Keresd meg az Abuko természetvédelmi területet az ország nyugati részén.
question.ro: Găsește rezervația naturală Abuko în vestul țării.
question.en: Find Abuko Nature Reserve in the west of the country.

question.de: Klicke auf die Region West Coast im Westen und Südwesten des Landes.
question.hu: Kattints a West Coast régióra az ország nyugati és délnyugati részén.
question.ro: Apasă pe regiunea West Coast din vestul și sud-vestul țării.
question.en: Click the West Coast region in the west and southwest of the country.

question.de: Finde die Region North Bank nördlich des Gambia-Flusses.
question.hu: Keresd meg a North Bank régiót a Gambia folyótól északra.
question.ro: Găsește regiunea North Bank la nord de fluviul Gambia.
question.en: Find the North Bank region north of the Gambia River.

question.de: Klicke auf die Region Central River im mittleren Osten des Landes.
question.hu: Kattints a Central River régióra az ország középső-keleti részén.
question.ro: Apasă pe regiunea Central River din partea central-estică a țării.
question.en: Click the Central River region in the central-east of the country.

question.de: Finde die Region Lower River südlich des Flusses im Landeszentrum.
question.hu: Keresd meg a Lower River régiót a folyótól délre, az ország középső részén.
question.ro: Găsește regiunea Lower River la sud de fluviu, în partea centrală a țării.
question.en: Find the Lower River region south of the river in the middle of the country.

question.de: Welcher Ort liegt nicht im westlichen Atlantik-Küstenraum?
question.hu: Melyik hely nem a nyugati atlanti partvidéken található?
question.ro: Care loc nu se află în zona atlantică vestică de coastă?
question.en: Which place is not in the western Atlantic coastal zone?

question.de: Welcher Ort gehört nicht zur historischen Achse Albreda-Juffureh an der Flussmündung?
question.hu: Melyik hely nem tartozik az albredai-juffurehi történelmi tengelyhez a torkolatnál?
question.ro: Care loc nu aparține axei istorice Albreda-Juffureh de la estuar?
question.en: Which place is not part of the Albreda-Juffureh historic axis at the estuary?

question.de: Welcher Ort liegt nicht im zentralen Flusskorridor Gambias?
question.hu: Melyik hely nem Gambia középső folyami folyosójában található?
question.ro: Care loc nu se află în coridorul central al fluviului din Gambia?
question.en: Which place is not in The Gambia's central river corridor?

question.ro: Care loc nu este o arie protejată sau un parc natural din vestul Gambiei?
question.en: Which place is not a protected area or nature park in western The Gambia?

question.de: Welche Stadt liegt nicht im Osten oder äußersten Nordosten des Landes?
question.hu: Melyik város nem az ország keleti vagy legészakkeletibb részén fekszik?
question.ro: Care oraș nu se află în estul sau extremul nord-est al țării?
question.en: Which town is not in the east or far northeast of the country?

question.de: Klicke Sanyang, Gunjur, Brikama und Banjul von West nach Ost an.

question.ro: Apasă Sanyang, Gunjur, Brikama și Banjul de la vest la est.
question.en: Click Sanyang, Gunjur, Brikama, and Banjul from west to east.

question.en: Click Kaur, Kuntaur, Janjanbureh, and Bansang from north to south.

question.en: Click Kuntaur, Janjanbureh, Bansang, and Basse Santa Su from west to east.

question.en: Click Barra, Kerewan, Farafenni, and Kaur from west to east.
